title: Meta taps skilled trades workers to power America’s AI infrastructure boom
excerpt: Meta is teaming up with NABTU to tap a massive skilled labor pipeline as the tech giant ramps up construction and maintenance of AI infrastructure in the U.S...
content_html:
Meta is partnering with North America's Building Trades Unions (NABTU) to expand the pipeline of skilled workers needed to build and maintain America's rapidly growing AI infrastructure.

The partnership, announced Wednesday, will give Meta access to NABTU's network of apprenticeship and training programs while helping connect skilled trades workers with Meta projects across the U.S.

"The Meta partnership with North America's Building Trades Unions means avenues of communication are open, access to our recruitment and training pipeline of skilled craft will become available, and we'll be able to deploy craft on an as-needed basis to Meta projects anywhere across America," Sean McGarvey, president of NABTU, told FOX Business.

Demand for skilled trades workers has grown rapidly as tech companies invest in data centers and other infrastructure needed to power AI.

McGarvey said the demand is being felt across a range of trades, including HVAC technicians, laborers, operating engineers and others.

NABTU represents more than 3.2 million skilled craft professionals in the U.S. and Canada through an alliance of 14 national and international unions. 

Its unions and contractor partners operate more than 1,900 apprenticeship and training facilities across North America and invest more than $3 billion annually in training and education, according to the announcement from Meta.

NABTU has roughly 300,000 people enrolled in its registered apprenticeship system, according to McGarvey, who added that number could grow significantly.

"We currently have that 300,000, and we can ramp that up to a million, based on demand," he said.

Meta President Dina Powell McCormick said skilled trades workers will be critical to building the infrastructure needed for the U.S. to compete in AI.

"We are so proud to work with NABTU on this partnership," Powell McCormick said in a statement. "I have had the privilege of working with President McGarvey since I took on this new role, and we are excited to work together on skilled trades.

"This is an important moment, and these men and women of the skilled trades are building the American infrastructure needed to ensure America's values lead the AI race globally."

content_html_zh:
Meta 正在与北美建筑工会 (NABTU) 合作，扩大建设和维护美国快速增长的人工智能基础设施所需的技术工人渠道。

周三宣布的合作伙伴关系将使 Meta 能够进入 NABTU 的学徒和培训计划网络，同时帮助技术工人与美国各地的 Meta 项目建立联系。

NABTU 总裁肖恩·麦加维 (Sean McGarvey) 告诉福克斯商业频道：“Meta 与北美建筑工会的合作意味着沟通渠道是开放的，我们将能够访问我们的熟练技术人员招聘和培训渠道，并且我们将能够根据需要将技术部署到美国任何地方的 Meta 项目。”

新墨西哥州法院命令 Meta 支付 5.67 亿美元，全面改革 Facebook 和 Instagram 上的青少年保护

随着科技公司投资数据中心和其他人工智能所需的基础设施，对技术工人的需求迅速增长。

麦加维表示，许多行业都感受到了这种需求，包括暖通空调技术人员、工人、操作工程师等。

在福克斯商业应用程序上阅读

NABTU 通过由 14 个国家和国际工会组成的联盟，代表美国和加拿大超过 320 万熟练手工艺专业人士。

根据 Meta 的公告，其工会和承包商合作伙伴在北美运营着 1,900 多个学徒和培训设施，每年在培训和教育方面的投资超过 30 亿美元。

扎克伯格提出了将超级人工智能交到每个人手中的愿景

McGarvey 表示，NABTU 约有 30 万人注册了其注册学徒系统，并补充说这一数字可能会大幅增长。

“我们目前拥有 30 万个，我们可以根据需求将其增加到 100 万个，”他说。

Meta 总裁迪娜·鲍威尔·麦考密克 (Dina Powell McCormick) 表示，熟练的行业工人对于建设美国人工智能竞争所需的基础设施至关重要。

鲍威尔·麦考密克在一份声明中表示：“我们非常自豪能够与 NABTU 合作建立这种伙伴关系。” “自从我担任这一新职务以来，我有幸与麦加维总裁合作，我们很高兴能够在技术行业合作。

“这是一个重要的时刻，这些技术行业的男男女女正在建设所需的美国基础设施，以确保美国的价值观引领全球人工智能竞赛。”

Meta 和其他公司必须面临数千起有关儿童社交媒体成瘾的诉讼，上诉法院规则
